definitions.gloss: residential land; building lot; land for housing
definitions.explanation: A plot of land designated or used for building houses and residences. An important concept in Japanese real estate, zoning, and property tax.

examples.japanese: {宅地|たくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{農地|のうち}→農地：14354_nouchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{宅地|たくち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: This area changed from farmland to residential land.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧{宅地|たくち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{利便性|りべんせい}→利便性：10681_ribensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧だ。
examples.english: Residential land near the station is expensive, but the convenience is outstanding.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{宅|たく}→宅：12302_taku⟧ (house, residence) and {地|ち} (land). A key term in Japanese real estate and land use. Japan distinguishes land categories for taxation and zoning purposes, with {宅地|たくち} being the designation for housing land.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宅地|たくち}⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧: residential land development
- {宅地|たくち}⟦{造成|ぞうせい}→造成：16756_zousei⟧: land preparation for housing
- {宅地|たくち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to purchase a residential lot
- {宅地|たくち}{建物|たてもの}{取引|とりひき}{業|ぎょう}: real estate transaction business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{敷地|しきち}→敷地：00365_shikichi⟧: site, grounds — the land on which a building stands
- {用地|ようち}: land for a specific purpose — general term for designated land
- ⟦{農地|のうち}→農地：14354_nouchi⟧: farmland — agricultural land, as opposed to residential
- ⟦{更地|さらち}→更地：17562_sarachi⟧: vacant lot — land with no buildings on it
